Seabyss II — Beta 0.1.7-beta.43

- Redesigned the Quest interface and rebalanced Quest rewards and XP progression.
- Added the 10-minute Captain equipment lock and clearer target-out-of-range HUD feedback.
- Updated World Boss rewards, spawn thresholds and reward-HUD delivery.
- Added Safe Maps PvP protections, world-map colors and safe-PvP messaging.

- Purchases remain disabled for this Beta release.
